As luck would have it though, Rei, the school troublemaker who also turns out to be her brother's dorm roommate, sees through her ruse on her first day! Prepared to be sent home immediately for her actions, Hinako is surprised when Rei decides to help her out with her plan.

Decades have passed since the Earth's magnetic poles disappeared, changing the balance forever. As the last remnants of humanity huddle in their bases, the remaining lifeforms have mutated into so-called xenogens and taken over the outside world.

In the midst of this war for life or death, a sentient mushroom lived his little life in the forest. That is, until humans came and took something precious from him — his spore. With his life's purpose gone, the young xenogen is ready to risk his life to reclaim it. So, donning a dead boy's face and calling himself An Zhe, the little mushroom makes an attempt to infiltrate a human base.

To get inside, he must first get past the Supreme Judge Lu Feng, whose job it is to detect and kill any mutants who try to sneak through the gate. It is said that nothing can escape his cold sight, which is now locked on An Zhe...

One day, while worrying about whether he could somehow get rid of those demons, Yukihiko encounters an especially fearsome demon. He escapes and meets a nun named Alicia inside a church, where he makes a contract with her to exterminate the demons that haunt him. However, without even getting magic training, she was attached to an assault squad, repeatedly fighting on the most cruel battlefields of the "Western Front."

The mission given to her was to become the personal medic of the frontline's ace, Garback, and not let him die at any cost. But he turned out to be the worst commander, who will try to get results whatever the cost, even if it means the death of his subordinates!

Kounosuke is a deadbeat, good-for-nothing living off his father's company dime and after his father is hospitalized, it's time for him to take responsibility! Kidnapped by his father's security team, he meets Rino, the busty bombshell who's also the company's head secretary who insists that he becomes the company's new President! Refusing to take the job, she offers to teach him how to be a proper leader, and that starts with giving up his virginity! Now behind the desk of his father’s company, four go-getting secretaries teach him everything to not only be a good leader, but a successful breeder!

Heaps of Boobs is a busty boardroom of tawdry deals by Nishizawa Mizuki that is looking to rule the top of the corporate ladder! Collecting the entirety of the mini-series "Lust", Nishizawa includes stories of reconnecting with a sporty childhood tomboy, a stunning coworker with a nerdy hobby, and a radiant housewife receiving more than just a package from a delivery man. With eleven executive-level chapters, Heaps of Boobs offers more than an eyeful and pays out in dividends!

Cleo Farshid has been disowned from his noble family due to his inability to be number one in anything at the Royal Academy. Cleo decides to escape his stuffy life and live more freely, taking advantage of his skills to become an adventurer. Neither he or his father have realized how amazing it is to be ranked as second in everything at a school where the most talented compete.

"I'm just an average person. I'm not an expert in anything." That sentiment kicks off an unmatched tale about a boy who is the strongest specifically because he's always second!

He had been peacefully spending the rest of his days indoors when he was ambushed by a group of masked people. During the ambush, he lost his servant who was like a sister to him. Chased by the attackers, Baek Yigang escaped through a secret underground path. When he came across a blocked path, he decided he’d at least die fighting and picked up a rusted sword that was stuck in the ground…

168934.description:
Cha Seo-Jin falls in love with Han Yi-Kyung, the older brother who lives next door with her since birth. Seo-Jin, who gradually develops feelings for him, confesses to Yi-Kyung, but he rejects him, saying he likes him as his younger brother, and they lose contact after their high school graduation. Then one day, Yi-Kyung and his son Gyul appear in front of Seo-Jin while he is out viewing cherry blossoms. The two quickly become close again, making the time they spent apart seem meaningless…

"Hyung, you have to hold back your noises. What if Gyul-woo wakes up?"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

168935.description:
Choi Jae-Won was living a carefree life abroad, surrounded by playful alphas and chasing nothing but pleasure. But when his father lures him back to Korea, he’s blindsided by a wedding—his own. The groom turns out to be Yang Joon-Hee, a childhood friend who’s grown into everything Jae-Won’s ever wanted. And before he can make sense of it, the vows are already said. Joon-Hee insists they once made a promise. Jae-Won doesn’t remember it... but something in him starts to respond anyway.

(Source: Lezhin US)

168936.description:
Joo-Hyuk has spent a lifetime at the bottom of the societal food chain as a recessive alpha. That hasn’t stopped him from maintaining a peculiar relationship with the dominant omega at the top of the food chain, Yoo-Sung. For ten years, Joo-Hyuk finds himself longing for Yoo-Sung, who only comes to him when he needs to hide away from the world for a night. After spending ten years as Yoo-sung’s occasional sanctuary, Joo-Hyuk, sick of his one-sided pining, puts an end to their arrangement. But are they really destined to end there? Or is there something written in the stars for them?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

168944.description:
"I'd be happy to marry you, but what's in it for you?"

Yoo is suddenly proposed to by her childhood friend Tsukasa, who is six years younger than her, and they end up married in the blink of an eye. The marriage allows Yoo to avoid pressure from her parents and helps her out at work, too, so a sham marriage is good for her, but what in the world are the advantages for Tsukasa?

(Source: Choco Love, translated)

168945.description:
Ahn Dongha is next in line to take over his village, but there’s just one problem: he can’t do so without a wife. The women of the village are clamoring at his feet to get a chance to convince him to wed…by any means necessary.

(Source: Lezhin US)

168948.description:
An android whose mission had been long completed finds a child abandoned in the ruins of a war-ravaged city. Amidst a dystopian world, a machine and human become mother and son.

This is the serialized version of the popular "Mechanical Buddy Universe" X comics by "Knight’s & Magic" author, Takuji Kato.

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.native: メカニカル バディ ユニバース 1.0

168953.description:
After the death of Michiko Kawabata, Mei Kashiyama began to suffer from anxiety, hallucinations, and fainting spells, as if someone else is in her head. Tatsuhiko Emaya met Mei when he saved her from a fall after she fainted. Through hypnosis by Emaya's uncle, a psychologist, she learns about the cause of her mental illness, and breaks free with Emaya's help.

(Source: Mangapedia, translated)

Note: Includes the additional chapter, M no Kaihou.

168954.description:
The princess residing in the Tower of Luna, with her transcendent beauty, she possesses a myriad of gorgeous men in her palace. Her desire for power and authority is unrivaled and she will stop at nothing to obtain what she wants. In the face of rival armies, she utilizes her beauty, charm, and wisdom to defend her homeland while on her way to becoming the greatest leader this land has seen.

(Source: Webcomics)

168955.description:
A woman reflects on the one regret that still lingers from when she was younger.

Honorable Mention in the Sunday Webry Newcomer Award for October 2022 in the 4-Page Division

168956.description:
Born of an illegitimate emperor and his cunning concubine, Luana oddly inherits the true imperial family's traits: blonde hair and blue eyes. After 8 long years of her wicked mother's abuse, she foresees an even bleaker fate in a dream: her death at 18 by her mother's hand. Determined to alter destiny, she looks for the true empress, crossing paths with her half-brother, Crown Prince Loudon, who reviles Luana's family. Can she defy fate, survive, and grasp the life she's meant for?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: องค์หญิงของทุกคน

168957.description:
Once a notorious master of the deviant sects, Nyeon-Bi Cheon pays a hefty price for her romance with a man of a virtuous sect, Won Gae of the True-spirited Sword. As her lover poisons her to death with a dragonsbane fruit, Nyeon-Bi perishes with more questions than answers. When she wakes up, however, she finds herself in a different sort of peril, as she reincarnates in the body of Noble Lady So-Yeo Cheon, a concubine of the imperial palace. As So-Yeo, Nyeon-Bi must rely on her knowledge from her past life to navigate both intrigue and romance in the palace!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: A Master, Who Woke Up as a Concubine
武林高手，一覺醒來變後宮
武林高手转生后宫小主

title.english: A Martial Master Wakes Up as a Concubine

168958.description:
Byun Soo-Ah, an impoverished novelist who only writes bad endings, is possessed by someone's curse as Choi Se-hwa, the villain of 'End of Youth', which is currently being serialized. Can Soo-Ah survive and return to her original world in a novel full of traitors, sociopaths, double personalities, and psychopaths?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Ending, I Want to Change It
วิธีหนีตายจากนิยายโรคจิต
執着系イケメンに殺されない方法

168959.description:
"This annoying mask...!!"

Kim Mu-Myeong, someone who has never been outside without a mask since birth. He enters a prestigious high school which is rumored to be the "worst" in obscurity, as he could smell and see the negative emotions of people. Amidst the unpleasant smells and incidents he constantly faces, can Mu-Myeong survive in this school?

(Source: Naver, translated)

168960.description:
After being reborn as a stalker villainess destined to die for trying to kill Archduke Calix Elluiden's lover, Charlize Lienta fled from the capital to stay away from the archduke at all costs. But her plan goes awry when she returns a year later and rescues a poor boy on the streets... because he turns out to be Sasha, Calix's long-lost nephew! Given her infamous reputation as Calix's stalker, will Charlize succeed in returning Sasha without raising the archduke's suspicions?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Male Lead's Nephew Loves Me So Much
หลานพระเอกสุดแสนจะปลื้มฉัน

title.english: Beloved by the Male Lead's Nephew

168961.description:
A mystery tale of young women gripped by the ghost of an encounter with a skeleton. "Eunha Chae" witnessed the shocking death of her friend a few years ago.

After the "skeleton incident", she herself turned into a psychological menace to her classmates because of her nightmares.

One day, "Soyeong Han", a girl claiming to have experienced something similar four years ago returns to school. And now she's asking Eunha for her help in finding out the truth.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.native: 義姉のパンティの向こう側

168965.description:
"What a sweet moan... Do me a favor and commit this feeling to memory, will you?"

When romance novelist Keito Shinohara gets assigned a shrewd new editor, both his writing and his personal life get a whole lot steamier!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title.english: The Sadistic Editor in Chief's Forbidden Guidance
title.native: ドS編集長のイケないご指導
title.romaji: Do S Henshuuchou no Ikenai Goshidou

168966.description:
An invisible man, a blind woman.

After a strange incident, Yo-Han turns invisible with only one friend knowing of his condition. After spending weeks frustrated and alone, he bumps into Eun-Ha, a blind girl, who doesn't realize that he is invisible. What happens when a boy who can't be seen meets a girl who can't see?

(Source: Manta)

168968.description:
"...It's a little punishment."

Izumi had adored the deity Bishamonten ever since he was a child. However, since the Kaguragis are a family that had been used as sacrificial offerings for generations, due to Izumi's constitution making him susceptible to being targeted by demons, he left his hometown when his parents passed away. But he returned to enter university. When he was attacked there by a shadowy figure, the deity appears and...? An interspecies love between the hottie Bishamonten and a pure-hearted university student with the constitution of a sacrificial offering!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

168969.description:
University student Mahiru lived his whole life utilizing a special power that lets him read the future of anyone he touches. He has always found this power useful, that is until he meets Kurosawa, the newbie at his part-time job. Despite how Kurosawa's looks are absolutely Mahiru's type in every way, for some reason, Kurosawa vehemently pulls away at the slightest touch.

When an accident on the stairs lead to a touch of hands between the two, Mahiru witnesses a future where the two of them kiss! Kurosawa then reveals that he has a power that brings bad luck to anyone he touches... but believes that Mahiru might be the key to lifting the curse!

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

168974.description:
Mo Lang, a bad boy, and Bai Qi, his genius friend, lived a quiet life in a village in the distant country of Niuzhan. Until one day, a mysterious assassin from the country of Xuanwu appears, who completely subverts their lives, forcing the two youngsters to embark on an adventure that will change the world. The manhua is a prequel to the animated series Scissor Seven, chronicling events from before the original series.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Scissor Seven: Black and White Twin Dragons

title.romaji: Wu Liuqi: Hei Bai Shuang Long

168975.description:
Utopolis is a high-rise city that's 7,000 meters tall. Zoe, a young girl who was born and raised in a town built inside an enormous building, has dreamed of traveling to the "outside world." However, the citizens of this city have an obligation imposed on them where they "must spend the rest of their lives in the building"...

(Source: COMIC MeDu, translated)

168976.description:
On a journey to defeat the king, Cal meets a mysterious boy named Abyss. Cal matures as he encounters various people, and Abyss, a boy with terrifying powers and thoughts. Are the two boys going to change the world...?!

(Source: Pie International, translated)

title.native: キングアビス アダマ篇

168977.description:
Robin, the young son of the prestigious Brawny family in Sussex (Southern England), wanders into the deep forest behind the mansion and meets a beautiful girl. A few years later, a girl who looks like her comes to the mansion. Then, strange things begin to happen to the family...

(source: Sukima, translated)

title.native: 曽祢まさこ短編集 ブローニイ家の悲劇
title.romaji: Sone Masako Tanpenshuu: Brawny-ke no Higeki

168978.description:
As a man witnesses his wife being kidnapped by an unidentified 'thing,' he throws himself into a manhole to track down the creature to rescue his beloved. While he is out to save his wife, he encounters unspeakably dark secrets behind a North Korean research connected with the monstrous creation. Would he be able to unveil the truth and safely save his pregnant wife?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes a prologue.

168980.description:
Monkey see, monkey do.

Sixth grader Xiao Yu finds herself in a tight spot when she runs into trouble with local delinquents. A mysterious boy steps in just in the nick of time and sends the bully flying — literally. When Xiao Yu asks about the source of his superhuman strength, he says he isn't human! So just what is he?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Tale of the Chinese Zodiac

168981.description:
I change schools every year due to my father's work. Whenever I go to a new school, I am always filled with hope and anxiety. However, the school I transferred to this time seems especially gloomy. My teacher tells me not to make friends with anyone and to stay away from other people... Why in the world would my teacher say something like that?

(Source: Sukima, translated)

title.native: ゆーれい学校恐怖日記

168983.description:
Mira lived comfortably as the princess of the Kingdom of Axia. Until one day when Mira is attacked by Leon, the prince of the neighboring kingdom, and dies vowing revenge against him. Mira wakes up to find time has rolled back to two months before the incident......? A reincarnation love story full of miscalculations, starting with revenge!

(Source: Comic Etoile, translated)

title.native: 殺してやろうと思った相手が溺愛してきて困ります
title.romaji: Koroshiteyarou to Omotta Aitei ga Dekiaishitekite Komarimasu

168984.description:
In search of a fourth member for the club, Mogari, Eugene, and new recruit Kaoru Kanzaki set their sights on Kotaro Tamon, a classmate who seems to be able to talk to ghosts. Unfortunately, Kotaro's got some major problems communicating with living humans! Will Kotaro be able to overcome his anxiety and join the Phantom Busters?

(Source: VIZ Media)

The story of Bob, who has contemplated suicide since he was 15. However he is always interrupted as he's about to go through with it.

Notes:

- Include the one shot "Odoritai no ni (踊りたいのに)"

168990.description:
Nanase moves into a share house when she enters high school. The house has a special rule where each resident is assigned a family role!

Father: Maki (female cop, 20 years old)
Mother: Tsugumi (female elementary school student, 10 years old)
Brother: Nanase (female high school student, 15 years old)
Sister: Karin (female junior high school student, 13 years old)

What will happen with Nanase's life with these people...!

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

title.romaji: Kanojo ga Onii-chan ni Nattara Shitai 10 no Koto

168993.description:
A man is upset by the attitude of a vicious bully girl! He rapes the girl and locks her in a warehouse for a month of confinement and training! The cocky mouth is covered with a rod, and her voluptuous body is devoured. On the last day of training, is there any salvation at the end of repeated humiliation?

(Source: DLsite, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Shingeki 2020-02

168996.description: April 1968. Student movements continued to spread around the world, and even in Japan, a storm was raging, centering on universities. Hiroshi Togi, a naive young man who came to Tokyo from Sendai as a trump card for the right-wing student activity unit, fulfills a fateful encounter on a chaotic campus where left-wing and right-wing students are jumbled together. Michiko Hojo, a lovely woman who grows plants on a run-down university campus. Hiroshi begins to become attracted to her, but she is also secretly acting as a left-wing secret weapon. In a turbulent era, the drama of love and revolution begins!
